visual_action: A slideshow of three still photos of Donald Trump. Each photo has text overlaid on it. In the photos, Trump is wearing a suit and tie and appears to be speaking at a podium or in a formal setting. An American flag is visible in the background of one photo.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Multiple photos of Donald Trump are shown throughout the video, and the on-screen text mentions "another Trump administration".

on_screen_text.text: Things Americans would suffer from under another Trump administration

T.T.O.T.A.C.A.
The termination of the
Affordable Care Act

People with:
- diabetes
- cancer
- heart disease
- asthma
- AIDS/HIV
(or currently pregnant)
could be denied coverage
for having a preexisting
condition

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video; only music plays.
audio_music: The video features the upbeat pop/disco song 'Murder On The Dancefloor' by Sophie Ellis-Bextor playing continuously throughout, creating a slightly ironic or jarring contrast with the serious subject matter presented in the on-screen text.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced slideshow of static images with text overlays.
cultural_references: Murder On The Dancefloor by Sophie Ellis-Bextor
central_claim: A second Donald Trump administration would terminate the Affordable Care Act, resulting in people with preexisting conditions being denied health insurance coverage.
intended_effect: To generate fear and concern about the potential negative healthcare consequences of a second Trump presidency.
